1	/**
2	 * Server-side data fetcher for WeekRevenueTrajectoryWidget.
3	 * Aggregates payments.amount_cents by calendar day for the current ISO week (Mon–Sun).
4	 * Also computes delta vs the same day range in the previous week.
5	 */
6	
7	type SupabaseClient = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof import('@/lib/supabase/server').createClient>>
8	
9	// ─── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
10	
11	export interface DayRevenue {
12	  /** YYYY-MM-DD */
13	  date: string
14	  /** total collected in cents */
15	  amountCents: number
16	  /** booking count that contributed to this day's payments */
17	  bookingCount: number
18	}
19	
20	export interface WeekRevenueData {
21	  days: DayRevenue[]
22	  /** Sum of this week so far — cents */
23	  totalCents: number
24	  /** Sum of equivalent days last week — cents */
25	  prevTotalCents: number
26	  /** Delta percent vs prev week (null when prev was 0) */
27	  deltaPercent: number | null
28	  /** Mon-0 index of "today" within the week (0=Mon … 6=Sun) */
29	  todayIndex: number
30	}
31	
32	// ─── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
33	
34	/**
35	 * Returns Monday 00:00:00 UTC for the ISO week containing `ref`.
36	 * JS getDay(): 0=Sun 1=Mon … 6=Sat  →  ISO: Mon is first day.
37	 */
38	function isoWeekMonday(ref: Date): Date {
39	  const d = new Date(ref)
40	  d.setUTCHours(0, 0, 0, 0)
41	  const day = d.getUTCDay() // 0=Sun
42	  const diffToMon = day === 0 ? -6 : 1 - day
43	  d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + diffToMon)
44	  return d
45	}
46	
47	function addDays(d: Date, n: number): Date {
48	  const result = new Date(d)
49	  result.setUTCDate(result.getUTCDate() + n)
50	  return result
51	}
52	
53	// ─── Main fetch ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
54	
55	export async function getWeekRevenueData(
56	  supabase: SupabaseClient,
57	  studioId: string,
58	): Promise<WeekRevenueData> {
59	  const now = new Date()
60	  const thisMonday = isoWeekMonday(now)
61	  const nextMonday = addDays(thisMonday, 7)
62	  const prevMonday = addDays(thisMonday, -7)
63	
64	  // ── This week's payments ──
65	  const { data: thisWeekPayments } = await supabase
66	    .from('payments')
67	    .select('amount_cents, created_at, booking_id')
68	    .eq('studio_id', studioId)
69	    .eq('status', 'succeeded')
70	    .neq('type', 'refund')
71	    .gte('created_at', thisMonday.toISOString())
72	    .lt('created_at', nextMonday.toISOString())
73	
74	  // ── Previous week's payments ──
75	  const { data: prevWeekPayments } = await supabase
76	    .from('payments')
77	    .select('amount_cents, created_at')
78	    .eq('studio_id', studioId)
79	    .eq('status', 'succeeded')
80	    .neq('type', 'refund')
81	    .gte('created_at', prevMonday.toISOString())
82	    .lt('created_at', thisMonday.toISOString())
83	
84	  // ── Build daily buckets for this week ──
85	  const buckets = new Map<string, { amountCents: number; bookingIds: Set<string> }>()
86	  for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
87	    const d = addDays(thisMonday, i)
88	    const key = d.toISOString().slice(0, 10)
89	    buckets.set(key, { amountCents: 0, bookingIds: new Set() })
90	  }
91	
92	  for (const p of thisWeekPayments ?? []) {
93	    const key = p.created_at.slice(0, 10)
94	    const bucket = buckets.get(key)
95	    if (bucket) {
96	      bucket.amountCents += p.amount_cents
97	      if (p.booking_id) bucket.bookingIds.add(p.booking_id)
98	    }
99	  }
100	
101	  const days: DayRevenue[] = []
102	  for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
103	    const d = addDays(thisMonday, i)
104	    const key = d.toISOString().slice(0, 10)
105	    const bucket = buckets.get(key) ?? { amountCents: 0, bookingIds: new Set() }
106	    days.push({
107	      date: key,
108	      amountCents: bucket.amountCents,
109	      bookingCount: bucket.bookingIds.size,
110	    })
111	  }
112	
113	  const totalCents = days.reduce((s, d) => s + d.amountCents, 0)
114	
115	  const prevTotalCents = (prevWeekPayments ?? []).reduce(
116	    (s, p) => s + p.amount_cents,
117	    0,
118	  )
119	
120	  const deltaPercent =
121	    prevTotalCents === 0
122	      ? null
123	      : Math.round(((totalCents - prevTotalCents) / prevTotalCents) * 100)
124	
125	  // todayIndex: 0=Mon … 6=Sun (matches days array index)
126	  const nowDay = now.getUTCDay() // 0=Sun
127	  const todayIndex = nowDay === 0 ? 6 : nowDay - 1
128	
129	  return { days, totalCents, prevTotalCents, deltaPercent, todayIndex }
130	}

42	  supabase: SupabaseClient,
43	  studioId: string,
44	): Promise<ArtistUtilizationData> {
45	  const now = new Date()
46	  const weekStart = isoWeekMonday(now)
47	  const weekEnd = new Date(weekStart)
48	  weekEnd.setUTCDate(weekEnd.getUTCDate() + 7)
49	
50	  const startIso = weekStart.toISOString()
51	  const endIso = weekEnd.toISOString()
52	
53	  // Fetch artists + their bookings this week in parallel
54	  // artists table uses `status` column — active artists have status='active'
55	  const [artistsRes, bookingsRes] = await Promise.all([
56	    supabase
57	      .from('artists')
58	      .select('id, display_name, avatar_url')
59	      .eq('studio_id', studioId)
60	      .eq('status', 'active'),
61	
62	    supabase
63	      .from('bookings')
64	      .select('artist_id, duration_min, status, scheduled_at')
65	      .eq('studio_id', studioId)
66	      .gte('scheduled_at', startIso)
67	      .lt('scheduled_at', endIso)
68	      .in('status', ['confirmed', 'completed', 'in_progress']),
69	  ])
70	
71	  const artists = artistsRes.data ?? []
72	  const bookings = bookingsRes.data ?? []
73	
74	  // Default available hours per artist for the week if no schedule data: 8h × 5 days
75	  const DEFAULT_WEEKLY_AVAILABLE_MINUTES = 8 * 60 * 5
76	
77	  // Aggregate booked minutes per artist
78	  const bookedMap = new Map<string, number>()
79	  for (const b of bookings) {
80	    const current = bookedMap.get(b.artist_id) ?? 0
81	    bookedMap.set(b.artist_id, current + (b.duration_min ?? 0))
82	  }
83	
84	  const rows: ArtistUtilRow[] = artists.map((a) => {
85	    const bookedMinutes = bookedMap.get(a.id) ?? 0
86	    const availableMinutes = DEFAULT_WEEKLY_AVAILABLE_MINUTES
87	    const utilizationPct = Math.min(
88	      100,
89	      Math.round((bookedMinutes / availableMinutes) * 100),
90	    )
91	
92	    return {
93	      artistId: a.id,
94	      name: a.display_name,
95	      avatarUrl: a.avatar_url ?? null,
96	      // artists table has no 'type' column — all are 'staff' at DB level
97	      // guest artist tracking is done via guest_artist_engagements table
98	      type: 'staff' as const,
99	      utilizationPct,
100	      bookedMinutes,
101	      availableMinutes,
102	    }
103	  })
104	
105	  // Sort: highest utilization first
106	  rows.sort((a, b) => b.utilizationPct - a.utilizationPct)
107	
108	  const weekLabel = weekStart.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
109	    month: 'short',
110	    day: 'numeric',
111	  })
112	
113	  return { rows, weekLabel }
114	}

28	function buildDueLabel(scheduledAt: string): { label: string; isOverdue: boolean } {
29	  const now = Date.now()
30	  const sessionMs = new Date(scheduledAt).getTime()
31	  const diffMs = sessionMs - now
32	
33	  if (diffMs < 0) {
34	    // Past session
35	    const hoursAgo = Math.round(Math.abs(diffMs) / (1000 * 60 * 60))
36	    return { label: `overdue ${hoursAgo}h`, isOverdue: true }
37	  }
38

40	  if (diffDays === 0) {
41	    const diffHours = Math.round(diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60))
42	    return { label: `today · ${diffHours}h left`, isOverdue: false }
43	  }
44	
45	  const dayName = new Date(scheduledAt).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'short' })
46	  return { label: `${dayName} · ${diffDays} day${diffDays !== 1 ? 's' : ''} left`, isOverdue: false }

3	 * Returns active guest artist residencies from guest_artist_engagements.
4	 * Returns null when no active residencies exist (widget should not render).
5	 */

12	  artistId: string
13	  name: string
14	  avatarUrl: string | null
15	  residencyEndAt: string
16	  daysRemaining: number
17	  bookingsDuringResidency: number
18	}
19	
20	export interface GuestResidencyData {
21	  rows: GuestResidencyRow[]
22	}

25	
26	export async function getGuestResidencyData(
27	  supabase: SupabaseClient,
28	  studioId: string,
29	): Promise<GuestResidencyData | null> {
30	  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString()
31	
32	  const { data, error } = await supabase
33	    .from('guest_artist_engagements')
34	    .select(`
35	      id,
36	      end_date,
37	      booking_count,
38	      artists!inner(id, display_name, avatar_url)
39	    `)
40	    .eq('studio_id', studioId)
41	    .eq('status', 'active')
42	    .gt('end_date', nowIso)
43	    .order('end_date', { ascending: true })
44	    .limit(5)
45	
46	  if (error || !data || data.length === 0) return null
47	
48	  type EngagementRow = {
49	    id: string
50	    end_date: string
51	    booking_count: number
52	    artists: {
53	      id: string
54	      display_name: string
55	      avatar_url: string | null
56	    }
57	  }
58	
59	  const engagements = data as unknown as EngagementRow[]
60	
61	  const rows: GuestResidencyRow[] = engagements.map((e) => {
62	    const endMs = new Date(e.end_date).getTime()
63	    const daysRemaining = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((endMs - Date.now()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)))
64	    return {
65	      artistId: e.artists.id,
66	      name: e.artists.display_name,
67	      avatarUrl: e.artists.avatar_url,
68	      residencyEndAt: e.end_date,
69	      daysRemaining,
70	      bookingsDuringResidency: e.booking_count,
71	    }
72	  })
73	
74	  return rows.length > 0 ? { rows } : null
75	}
